correctness.rationale: Normalized implicit equation e^{-a delta}+sum_{n>=3} M^{-lambda_n}e^{-log n delta}-1=0, M=m-1, a=log2, has derivative <=-a/2 near the unique root. The exponent semigroup is locally finite because generators lambda_n increase and have a positive minimum. Recursive formal extraction cancels coefficients in strictly increasing exponent order. For any B the n-tail is O_B(M^-B) by integral comparison and the finite truncated exponentials contribute O_B(M^-B); mean-value inversion gives an actual all-orders asymptotic with fixed-cutoff error. Reconstructed the six exponents below theta=log_2(7/2) and the nontrivial n=6 versus n=3/4 mixed resonance coefficient -log3/(log2)^2. Independent high-precision actual zeta root checks at M=10^4,10^6,10^8,10^10 confirm truncation scaled by M^theta remains bounded, which does not prove uniform B claims.
